name: test_file_service.py
summary: Unit tests for FileService file validation logic verifying rejection of oversized files and PDF documents.
purpose: Ensures that FileService correctly enforces upload constraints by rejecting invalid file sizes and unsupported formats (PDF), protecting downstream processing from malformed inputs and storage abuse.
responsibilities: Verify that FileService rejects files exceeding the maximum allowed size
Verify that FileService rejects PDF file types during validation
Isolate FileService behavior using mocks to avoid external dependencies
Provide fast regression feedback on file upload validation rules
inputs: Invalid file metadata simulating oversized and PDF inputs
outputs: Assertion results confirming expected validation failures
Regression safety for file upload constraint logic
architecture_notes: Implements isolated unit testing within a pytest framework, utilizing unittest.mock.MagicMock to stub file dependencies and avoid I/O or integration concerns. The module follows Django/Python conventions by residing in an app-scoped tests directory and targets negative validation paths (rejection scenarios), suggesting complementary positive-path coverage is needed elsewhere in the suite.
improvements: Expand coverage to include valid file scenarios (happy path) and additional invalid MIME types
Introduce pytest fixtures to standardize MagicMock configuration and reduce duplication
Add parameterized tests for boundary size values (exactly at limit, slightly over, zero-byte)
Include explicit assertions on error messages to validate user-facing feedback
Add docstrings linking tests to specific business requirements or ticket references
